round_3_findings_remediation_verified.title: candidate_id must drop the hardcoded absolute fallback and fail closed from an unrecognized root
round_3_findings_remediation_verified.evidence: candidate_id.gleam contains no absolute path literal; read_core_source/2 tries only <root>/src/cepaf_gleam/<rel> then <root>/apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/<rel>. current() honors UOS_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT and falls back to ".", with blank/whitespace env degrading to ".". A repo-wide grep of src/cepaf_gleam/mcp found the absolute repo path only in server.gleam:1020,1022 (the gleam build toolchain invocation), never in candidate identity. supervisor.gleam carries no path literal and start_worker_pool (supervisor.gleam:85-91) requires is_sha256_digest. is_sha256_digest enforces the "sha256:" prefix, byte_size == 71 and 64 lowercase hex graphemes.
round_3_findings_remediation_verified.falsification_attempted: Executed from an unrecognized root: from_root("/tmp") -> UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE; from_root("") -> UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE; with process cwd set to /tmp and no env, current() -> UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE; with UOS_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT set to the repo root from /tmp, current() -> the true candidate; with a whitespace-only env value from /tmp, current() -> UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE (no silent reuse of another checkout). Length and alphabet falsifiers on is_sha256_digest: 70-byte false, 72-byte false, non-hex tail false, "UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE" false. Runtime gating falsified end to end: start_worker_pool(1) from /tmp -> {error,"unobserved_or_invalid_source_candidate"}; start_worker_pool_for_candidate(1,"uos-mcp") and (1,"UNOBSERVED_CANDIDATE_SOURCE") -> {error,"invalid_worker_pool_candidate"}; from the repo root the pool binds the true SHA-256 candidate.
